The brief facts of the case are that on 01.01.2024 at 20:00 hours received a complaint from 1. S Raju, SI of Police, Bowenpally PS, Hyderabad, Phno: 8712660282. They caught them and when questioned about the bag, they started giving evasive replies and became panic. On further interrogation they revealed that the bag is containing Hashish Oil extracted from Ganja which they are taking to deliver to the customers. On enquiry they revealed their names as 1) Chandaluri Srinivasa Rao S/o Late Ch Venkateshwarlu, Chakali caste, 29 years, Process Associate at Amazon Hub, Shamshabad N/o Jarugumalli (v) Tanguturu mdl Prakasham district R/o H# 1-68/A, Old Hafeezpet, Miyapur and 2) Akaram Ranjith Kumar S/o Akaram Mallesh, 28 years. Then he informed them that illegal possession and selling of Narcotics Drug is an offence under NDPS Act. Then, he sent PC-30017 to the PS with instructions to bring the laptop, mini printer along with weighing machine and stationary. Accordingly, the constable brought them. Meantime, he secured the presence of mediators 1) Debba Sammaiah S/o Chinnaiah, 31 years, Special RI, Tirumalagiri Tahasil Office R/o P# 38, Srinagar colony, Tirumalgiri, Hyderabad (7386255407) and 2) Torupunoori Ankush Kumar Goud S/o T Kumar, 32 years, business R/o H# 9-2-48/2, Royal Enclave, Hasmathpet, Old Bowenpally. In the year 2017 he completed his B Tech from Nitte Meenakshi Institute of Technology, Bangalore, Karnataka state. When his father expired in the year 2014 while he was pursuing B Tech, he felt loneliness and addicted to Ganja and Hashish oil. After the studies, he got a job at Sykes, Bangalore but after the first lock down he came to Hyderabad. He was continuously consuming Hashish Oil and Ganja by purchasing it from Kishore and Kalu of Dhoolpet. He got job in Amazon and was getting monthly salary of 35,000/-. He along with his friend Vinod visited Lambasingi (tourist place) of East Godavari district, purchased Hashish Oil from one Sandeep of Chitapally, Annavaram. On 14/08/2020, he married Smt Aparna but his earnings were not sufficient to lead the family. As he knew there is heavy demand in Hyderabad for the Hashish Oil, he hatched a plan to procure the Hashish Oil from Sandeep and to sell it to needy customers at inflated price to make easy money. As per his plan, for last two years, he was procuring Hashish Oil from Sandeep at 57,000/- per One Kilogram packed in small plastic containers of 5 Grams each and sold it to the needy customers at 2,000/- each container. In the month of June 2023, he was arrested by Qutbullapur Excise police under NDPS Act. He got acquainted to Ranjith Kumar through a common friend Nitish. Ranjith is also addicted to Ganja consumption. After few days, Ranjith informed that he was also selling Ganja to needy customers. On that he offered commission to Ranjith if he assisted in the sale of Hashish Oil for which he has readily agreed and joined hands with him. Then they both procured Hashish Oil from Sandeep and sold to the needy customers. On asking about his customers, he opened his iPhone-13 and showed customers name and cell number in his contact list as 1) Srinivas cell No 9989059533; 2) Nagoor, Cell No 9703201506; 3) Shannu, Cell No 9959023243; 4) Abhishek Cell No 8106001865; and 5) Akshay, Cell No 9381244515. On 22/12/2023 they both went to Lambasinge and met Sandeep and procured one Kilogram of Hashish Oil paying 57,000/- and transported it to Hyderabad and retained it in his house for later disposal. Today i.e., on 01/01/2024 evening after Ranjith came to him, both of them left with Hashish Oil to pack it in small plastic containers at the house of Ranjith at RR Nagar. When they reached the HAL colony park they were apprehended. Then he produced the plastic bag containing the Hashish Oil extracted from Ganja. On weighing, it is found weighing (1025) grams. The same was put in another plastic cover, pasted with adhesive tape, and the same was put in a gauge cloth cover, and pasted and sealed with Lakka with Police Station seal and marked as P-1. He also produced one Apple make iPhone 13 model. It was put in another zip lock cover and the same was put in a gauge cloth cover, pasted, sealed with Lakka and police station seal and marked as P-2. Later he have recorded confessional statement of the another person A2 Akaram Ranjith Kumar S/o Akaram Mallesh, 28 years, Jangam caste R/o Omkareshwara Agency (Sanitary) near Mahankali Temple, Rani Gunj, Secunderabnad R/o H.no: 8-8-65, RR Nagar, Old Bowenpally, Secunderabad. He has confessed the offence as confessed by the first accused and also disclosed that he was arrested by police in two cases in the past in Ghatkesar and Nacharam PS under NDPS Act cases. Then he produced one Realme make cell phone. It was put in another zip lock cover and it was put in a gauge cloth cover, pasted, sealed with Lakka and police station seal and marked as P-3. Since they were not carrying anything in their personal possession, the service of Gazetted officer is not taken. The supplier of Hashish Oil namely Sandeep of Chintapally, Annavaram, AP State and consumers/customers 1) Srinivas cell No 9989059533; 2) Nagoor, Cell No 9703201506; 3) Shannu, Cell No 9959023243; 4) Abhishek Cell No 8106001865; and 5) Akshay, Cell No 9381244515 are absconding. Hence he is producing the above said two persons along with the seized property for necessary action.

IN THE COURT OF THE HONOURABLE XVI TH ADDITIONAL CHIEF METROPOLITAN MAGISTRATE, HYDERABAD
Honoured Sir,

            Today i.e. on 02-01-2024 at 15.30 hours, received an English typed report from Sri. G Rajeswara Reddy, Sub-Inspector of Police, which reads as follows.
                                                                                                         Dated: 02.01.2024.
To
The Inspector of Police,
P.S Shahinayathgunj, Hyd.

Sir,
	I G Rajeswara Reddy, Sub-Inspector of Police submitting that today i.e., on 02.01.2024 at 1230 hrs while I was  at Police Station I received a credible information from the source, that one person is in illegal possession of Narcotic Drug ‘Ganja’ near Santhoshi Matha temple, Jhinsi Chowraha, Hyderabad. Believing the information to be true and authentic, I followed the guidelines and informed the same to my superior officer U/Sec 42(2) NDPS Act. I obtained permission from ACP, Goshamahal to verify the veracity of information. I along with staff Sri K. Shiva Kumar, PC 6096 and Sri. D. Babu, PC 8903 rushed to the spot at 1300 hours, along with sufficient NDPS investigation kit. On reaching there we found one person carrying black colour polythene cover in suspicious manner and by seeing us in uniform, he tried to flee away from the spot along with vehicle but immediately I along with my staff apprehend him. I asked for the reason of his escape and, on that he revealed that he concealed Ganja in the black cover. Further he informed that he is not hiding any type of drugs in his physical possession (under his clothes), as such Sec.50 NDPS Act not complied. Further secured the presence of two mediators to act as panchas for recording confession cum seizure panchanama. On further enquiry in presence of aforesaid mediators, he revealed his particulars as Rajesh Singh S/o Late Eshwar Singh, age: 52 yrs, Occ: Painter R/o H.No: 14-8-273, Opp GHMC Ward Office, Jummerath Bazar, Hyderabad, Cell: 8125411977 and he further confessed that he is procuring Ganja from the residence of Anguri Bai & Aruna Bai R/o Balram Galli, Mangalhat, Hyderabad for lower price and selling the same to needy customers at higher prices. As usual few days back he procured Ganja and sold a part of it by making into small sachets and today i.e., on 02.01.2023 at about 1300 hrs he reached near Santhoshi Matha temple, Jhinsi Chowraha, Hyderabad to sell the remaining Ganja in meantime, on a tip of information we apprehended him. Further in the presence of mediators, recorded the confession cum seizure of Rajesh Singh seized the black cover containing 22 sachets and each packet found weighing about 20 Grams. All the sachets were cut opened and found Ganja (green leafy flowering tops & buds – appearance & odour as Ganja). In the presence of panchas all the sachets were opened and poured them in a sheet and mixed thoroughly and the total Ganja weighing about 440 Grams was filled in a white polythene cover and marked it as P-1. Today i.e., on 04-01-2024 at 0130 hours received a complaint from Sri E. Edukondalu, Sub-Inspector of Police, PS Vanasthalipuram. Which reads as follows.

Facts of the case are that on 03.01.2024 at 2200 hours, while the complainant was present in Police Station, received credible information that one person is in possession of Ganja illegally and trying to sell the same to the needy Customer in front of MRR Bar, Auto Nagar, Vanasthalipuram. He made a GD Entry, informed the same to my Superior officers as envisage U/s 42(2) NDPS Act, 1985 and obtained permission from ACP Vanasthalipuram to verify the veracity of information. As, the complainant has empowered to exercise the powers provided U/s 41 & 52 (3) of Narcotics Drugs and Psychotropic Substance Act 1985 (Central Act 61 of 1985) after making GD entry, he along with his staff i.e., Sri B. Deelip Reddy, PC 9743 and Sri J. Mahesh, HG 468 left PS by taking weighing machine, Laptop, Mini printer & other necessary tool kit available in the PS, and reached the spot at about 2300 hours, in front of MRR Bar, Auto Nagar, Vanasthalipuram, where they found one person under suspicious manner as given information by informant, and when he tried to flee away, they rounded up him and questioned regarding his presence at the said place. He evaded their questionnaires’ by giving evasive replies, as such he was taken into custody. On further thorough enquiry, he revealed his name as Marri Srikanth, S/o Venkanna, Aged 22 years, Occ: Driver, Caste: SC (Mala), R/o. backside of RSS Ground, NGO’s Colony, Vanasthalipuram, R.R. Dist., N/o Anandapuram Village, Aswapuram Mandal, Bhadadri Kothagudem Dist., and on enquiry he stated that he is possession ganja in the plastic cover carried by him for sale to the needy customers,  then the complainant served with Notice U/s. 50 NDPS about his rights to be searched before Gazetted officer/ Magistrate for which they he gave his consent to be searched in the presence of any Gazetted officer. On that the complainant gave a requisition U/s 50 (2) of NDPS Act to the Gazetted officer by name Sri B. Venkat, Detective-Inspector of Police, Vanasthalipuram PS. After arrival of Gazetted Officer, he verified the plastic cover in the presence of mediators and above gazetted officer and found one packet wrapped with brown colour tape. Later he had cut the packet and found loose ganja.  Immediately the complainant recorded the detailed confessional statement of said person in the presence of above mediators and gazetted officer and opened the entire packet, weighed the ganja and found to be 02 KGs and he had kept the entire ganja into another cover and kept the brown tape in another cover and sealed both the cover with lac seal, marked the ganja cover as M1 and another cover as P1 and also seized one mobile phone which was marked as M2, from his possession under the cover of panchanama by duly affixing the signed panch chits of above mediators and Gazetted Officer. The said person in his confession stated that five years ago his family has come down to NGOs Colony, Hyderabad for eking their livelihood and he is eking his livelihood by working as car driver. Hence the FIR
